sentences.text: Mr. Ashish Tiwari - Advocate for the appellant.

Mr. Rahul Solanki appearing on behalf of Advocate Genera  Heard on IA No.2492/2025 , which is first application un  430(1) of the BNSS, 2023 seeking suspension of sentence on beh  o f appellant Kesu @ Kishore who have been convicted under sec  and 471 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 3 years R.I. & 2 y  fine of Rs.20,000 - Rs.1,000/- and 500/- with default stipulat  judgment dated 24.12.2024 in ST/408/2019 by the 8th Additional  Judge, Ujjain (M.P.)
 Counsel for the appellant submitted that appellant is in  has falsely been implicated in the aforementioned crime.
It is  submitted that the appellant has surrendered before the trial   appeal is of the year 2025 and its final disposal would take c  time to conclude.
Hence, in such circumstances, prayer is made  the appellant on bail.

Counsel for the respondent/State opposed the application Considering the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties coupled with the fact that the sentence is of limited period and its final disposal would take long time, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application (IA No.2492/2025) is allowed and it is directed that the 2 CRA-1953-2025 execution of remaining jail sentence passed against appellant shall remain suspended subject to their depositing the fine amount (if already not deposited) and furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 03.03.2026 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this appeal.
